**Live data since ${go_live}; earlier history was imported.** Flight and controller summaries from 24-08-2025 to 15-03-2026 were imported from the previous system (imported flights have no speed, altitude or SELCAL). There is no data from 15-03-2026 to ${go_live}. Panels for the last 7 or 30 days, and the live tables, show current data only. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Most popular military aircraft (unique pilots, last 7 days)
panels.description: Pilots per military aircraft type over the selected time range (default last 7 days).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.aircraft, t.pilots, t.flights,
       round(100.0 * t.pilots / sum(t.pilots) OVER (), 2) AS "% of pilots"
FROM (
  SELECT f.aircraft_icao AS aircraft, count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS pilots, count(*) AS flights
  FROM flight_ext f
  JOIN aircraft_type a ON a.icao = f.aircraft_icao
  WHERE a.in_v1_card65_list
    AND f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY f.aircraft_icao
) t
ORDER BY t.pilots DESC, t.flights DESC, t.aircraft

panels.title: Most popular RAAFv routes (last month)
panels.description: Most popular RAAFv routes over the last month (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.route_label AS route,
       count(*) AS total_flights,
       count(DISTINCT r.cid) AS unique_pilots,
       round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv flights",
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT r.cid) / sum(count(DISTINCT r.cid)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv pilots"
FROM (
  SELECT f.cid, f.route_label,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.session_id ORDER BY f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
    AND f.departure <> '' AND f.arrival <> ''
) r
WHERE r.rn = 1
GROUP BY r.route_label
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, unique_pilots DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Hours flown by RAAFv aircraft per week (last 14 weeks)
panels.description: Airborne hours flown by RAAFv flights per week over the last 98 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       round((sum(f.airborne_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "RAAFv hours"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: RAAFv flights (last 7 days)
panels.description: RAAFv flights that logged on in the last 7 days, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.callsign, f.cid, f.name,
       upper(btrim(f.aircraft_icao)) AS aircraft_type,
       f.departure, f.arrival, f.remarks, f.logon_time
FROM flight f
WHERE f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
  AND f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY f.logon_time DESC, f.callsign
LIMIT 500

panels.title: RAAFv flights by aircraft type (last 30 days)
panels.description: RAAFv flights, airborne hours and average hours per flight by aircraft type over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(f.aircraft_icao, ''), '(none)') AS aircraft_type,
       count(DISTINCT f.session_id) AS total_flights,
       round(sum(COALESCE(f.airborne_minutes, 0))) AS total_airborne_minutes,
       round(sum(COALESCE(f.airborne_minutes, 0)) / 60.0, 2) AS total_airborne_hours,
       round(avg(COALESCE(f.airborne_minutes, 0)) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_airborne_hours_per_flight
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_airborne_hours DESC, aircraft_type
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Most popular RAAFv aircraft last month (flights)
panels.description: RAAFv flights by aircraft type over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.aircraft AS aircraft,
       count(*) AS "Flights",
       round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2) AS "% of RAAFv flights"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(btrim(f.aircraft_icao)), ''), '(none)') AS aircraft,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.session_id ORDER BY f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight f
  WHERE f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
    AND f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.aircraft
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, t.aircraft
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Flights flown by RAAFv aircraft per week (last 14 weeks)
panels.description: RAAFv flights per week over the last 98 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(*) AS "RAAFv flights"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.remarks ILIKE '%RAAFVIRTUAL.ORG%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
